name: rustdesk
title: Rustdesk
description: Search local RustDesk peers and connect
author: fred_lordick

commands.name: rustconnect
commands.title: Rustconnect
commands.description: Search devices and connect with RustDesk

preferences.name: enableOnlineStatus
preferences.title: Online status
preferences.label: Show online/offline from Server Pro API
preferences.description: Optional. Needs API base URL + token from the web console (Settings → Tokens, Device permission). Off by default.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API base URL
preferences.description: Server Pro API root, e.g. https://rustdesk.example.com (no trailing path).

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API token
preferences.description: Bearer token from Server Pro web console. Never commit this value.

preferences.name: offlineAfterMinutes
preferences.title: Offline after (minutes)
preferences.description: If API only returns last-seen time, treat older than this as offline.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
